scope: Deterministic fail-closed classification of SEC Form 4 transaction codes

contract.open_market_trade: Only a non-derivative P/A purchase or S/D sale with a documented code and consistent direction
contract.other_documented_codes: Normalized to compensation or other-transaction evidence, retain VERIFIED code classification, require human review and never become an open-market trade
contract.unknown_or_direction_inconsistent: INSIDER_OTHER_TRANSACTION / UNVERIFIED with UNRECOGNIZED_OR_INCONSISTENT transaction type and human review required
contract.event_value: Calculated only for a verified open-market P/A or S/D transaction
contract.knowledge_time: Existing filing and transaction knowledge-time guards remain unchanged

tests.note: A prior clean-host full-suite attempt had 22 dependency import errors. After installing the repository-declared requirements, the recorded full run passed; the failed import attempt is not counted as a pass.

acceptance_limits.reason: This is deterministic local code and regression evidence only. It does not establish live issuer/person identity, live Form 4 cases, Windows end-to-end acceptance, coverage or historical predictive value.
